arguments.content:
teleop_arm_controller:
  ros__parameters:
    action_monitor_rate: 20.0
    allow_partial_joints_goal: false
    cmd_timeout: 0.2
    command_interfaces:
    - position
    constraints:
      goal_time: 0.0
      stopped_velocity_tolerance: 0.0
    interpolate_from_desired_state: true
    joints:
    - xarm_joint1
    - xarm_joint2
    - xarm_joint3
    - xarm_joint4
    - xarm_joint5
    - xarm_joint6
    state_interfaces:
    - position
    - velocity
    state_publish_rate: 50.0
    type: joint_trajectory_controller/JointTrajectoryController
    use_sim_time: true

teleop_gripper_controller:
  ros__parameters:
    action_monitor_rate: 20.0
    allow_partial_joints_goal: false
    command_interfaces:
    - position
    constraints:
      goal_time: 0.0
      stopped_velocity_tolerance: 0.0
      xarm_drive_joint:
        goal: 0.0
        trajectory: 0.0
    interpolate_from_desired_state: true
    joints:
    - xarm_drive_joint
    set_last_command_interface_value_as_state_on_activation: true
    state_interfaces:
    - position
    - velocity
    type: joint_trajectory_controller/JointTrajectoryController
    use_sim_time: true
